capabilities.owner_visible_outcome: Получить обычный текстовый ответ по принятой задаче.
capabilities.minimum_route_profile: existing Core -> general answer worker -> verified outbox
capabilities.authoritative_success_evidence: tenant/task/revision-bound verified result in authoritative outbox
capabilities.safe_failure: FAILED or UNAVAILABLE without fabricated result
known_limitations: Current admission can falsely reject material containing unreleased-intent keywords.
capabilities.authority_requirement: verified TrustedAdmissionContext and independent Core mapping/policy; model role alone is never authority

admission_binding_policy.reference_failure: TRUST_VIOLATION -> REFUSE; selected_capability=null; no TaskContract; no effect
admission_binding_policy.privileged_operation_rule: Model role=requested/conditional is necessary but insufficient; trusted provenance must be DIRECT_OWNER_COMMAND with OWNER_REQUESTED or OWNER_CONDITIONAL, every reference must be VERIFIED, and Core policy must independently allow the capability.
admission_binding_policy.heterogeneous_task_rule: If authoritative requested/conditional operations map to more than one distinct capability, decide HETEROGENEOUS_CAPABILITIES with reason HETEROGENEOUS_COMPOUND_UNSUPPORTED_V1, selected_capability=null, no partial TaskContract and no effect.
admission_binding_policy.conditional_predicate_rule: Only one conditional operation is allowed in contract v1 and only with the closed material_item_state_exists predicate; Core's server evaluator produces TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN. FALSE and UNKNOWN create no TaskContract, approval or effect; only TRUE may continue to approval/execute.
